messages.subject: Error trying to install dev version from github: Error in evaluate(...) unused arguments
parts:
Hi

I tried to use the dev version with: install_github('knitr', 'yihui')
but the package fails whilke trying to create the vignette. Not sure
whether this is a big issue, but reporting it in case. Maybe I should
update other dependencies?
